title: TaleTeller
description: Explore three watercolor worlds, discover picture words, choose what happens next, and tell the finished tale in your own voice.
learningGoals: Build expressive vocabulary by naming illustrated story clues
Connect choices to cause and effect in a simple narrative
Practice sequencing and retelling a complete story aloud
interactionModel: tap four picture-word hotspots, make two sequential illustrated choices, then listen and hold to record an original retelling
feedbackModel: each discovery animates, speaks the word in context, and joins a picture-token strip; every choice changes the narrated sentence; the finale supports private local replay or a guided speak-aloud fallback

modes.title: Forest
modes.skill: name forest clues and choose how Pip crosses the stream

modes.title: Ocean
modes.skill: name ocean clues and choose Willa’s underwater adventure

modes.title: Moon
modes.skill: name moon clues and choose Nova’s space adventure
